t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It helps to keep your fingers over the keys to memorise which gnome belongs to which group. There are two groups of 4 gnomes which will be led to different coloured baskets. As long as something makes more than 4 mushrooms, memorise and pick it.

vb_textbox.text: In the game you will see two separate groups. Group 1 are pink, purple, brown and yellow. These need to be directed to the red basket. Whereas blue, yellow, green and orange should be directed to the yellow basket. Choose which colour you would like to start with and if it produces 3 or less mushrooms, move to the other colour that produces 4 or more and memorise this choice. Try to keep your fingers over the keys 's' and 'k' to make it easier to choose the colours.
